name: diagonal-band-walk
instructions:
1. Begin in an athletic position with your knees bent, hips flexed, and eyes looking straight ahead. Wrap a band around your legs just above your knees.
2. Keep the feet roughly shoulder width apart and take diagonal steps side to side as you move forward.
3. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions both forwards and backwards.
